meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 当你报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex 相关 bug 时,它会先跑调试、拉取最新源码、确认根因,再决定该提到哪个 GitHub 仓库,产出一份带环境、复现步骤、根因和修复建议的 issue(仅上游可提 PR)。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或排查 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时接管;根因与复现路径不明确前不会建单。

say.text: 帮我报告一个 LazyCodex 安装失败的问题
say.note: 它会先查源码确认该提哪个仓库,再建 issue

say.text: 先搜一下有没有人已经报过这个 bug
say.note: 找到就补证据评论,不重复建单

howto.what_en: It investigates LazyCodex or Codex bugs, pulls fresh sources, confirms the root cause, decides which GitHub repo owns the defect, then files an issue (or upstream PR) with environment, repro steps, root cause and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open or triage a bug in LazyCodex, a Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI; it won't file until root cause and reproduction are concrete.

say_en.text: Help me report a LazyCodex install failure
say_en.note: It checks sources and picks the owning repo first

say_en.text: File this Codex CLI bug as an issue on openai/codex
say_en.note: A PR is only created when you ask and a fix exists

say_en.text: Search first for an existing issue on this bug
say_en.note: It comments with new evidence instead of duplicating
